item.title: Open-Source Vanta Alternatives in 2026: CISO Assistant vs GigaChad GRC vs Unicis
item.description: Compliance automation platforms quote $7,000–$25,000 per year for a small team, and the price scales with headcount rather than with how much compliance work you actually do. That pricing model is exactly why the self-hosted governance, risk and compliance (GRC) space has quietly become one of the most active corners of open source: the data is yours — controls, evidence, risks, vendors — and the frameworks are public documents.
